items.exampleEn: He tactfully changed the subject when money came up.
items.exampleZh: 一談到錢，他就很得體地轉移了話題。

items.exampleEn: In the army, insubordination is taken very seriously.
items.exampleZh: 在軍中，抗命是非常嚴重的事。

items.exampleEn: The garden was designed to keep the naturalness of the hills around it.
items.exampleZh: 這座花園的設計保留了周圍山丘的自然樣貌。

items.exampleEn: Crowded trains can bring on claustrophobia in some passengers.
items.exampleZh: 擁擠的火車可能會讓某些乘客產生幽閉恐懼。

items.exampleEn: "Is that all you can do?" the coach asked scornfully.
items.exampleZh: 「你就只會這樣嗎？」教練輕蔑地問。

items.exampleEn: Her youngest son is a real imp who hides everyone's keys.
items.exampleZh: 她的小兒子是個十足的小淘氣鬼，老是把大家的鑰匙藏起來。

items.exampleEn: Being the only doctor on the island puts her in an unenviable position.
items.exampleZh: 身為島上唯一的醫生，讓她處在一個艱難、不令人羨慕的處境。

items.exampleEn: The afternoon sun shone benignly on the quiet village.
items.exampleZh: 午後的陽光溫和地照在寧靜的村莊上。

items.sentenceEn: Nobody wanted the unenviable job of telling the boss the bad news.
items.sentenceZh: 沒有人想接下把壞消息告訴老闆這種吃力不討好的工作。

items.audioEn: The receptionist smiled benignly and told us not to worry about our late arrival.
items.audioZh: 櫃台人員和藹地笑了笑，要我們別擔心晚到的事。
options: The receptionist was annoyed that we were late.
The receptionist was kind and gentle.

items.sentenceEn: The manager answered the angry customer tactfully and calmly.
items.sentenceZh: 經理得體又冷靜地回應了那位生氣的客人。

items.sentenceEn: That little imp has eaten all the cookies again!
items.sentenceZh: 那個小淘氣鬼又把餅乾全吃光了！

items.stemEn: The sailor was punished for ____ after he refused the captain's orders.
items.stemZh: 那名船員違抗船長的命令，因不服從上級而受罰。

items.stemEn: He looked ____ at my old phone, as if it were rubbish, and then showed me his new one.
items.stemZh: 他輕蔑地看了看我的舊手機，好像那是垃圾一樣，然後秀出他的新手機。

items.passageEn: The young director Nina had the unenviable job of shooting a whole scene inside a tiny elevator. Her lead actor, Max, suffered from claustrophobia, so she reassured him and tactfully suggested short takes with the doors opened between them. One crew member, however, refused to follow her schedule and laughed scornfully at her plan. The producer called it insubordination and sent him home. The child actor in the film, a cheerful little imp, kept everyone's spirits up between takes. Critics later praised the naturalness of the acting, and the producer smiled benignly when Nina won an award for the film.
items.passageZh: 年輕導演 Nina 接下一份吃力不討好的工作：整場戲都要在一部狹小的電梯裡拍。她的男主角 Max 有幽閉恐懼症，所以她先安撫他，再得體地建議每次拍短一點，中間把電梯門打開。不過，有一位劇組人員不肯照她的時間表做，還輕蔑地嘲笑她的計畫。製片說這是不服從上級，把他送回家。片中的童星是個開朗的小淘氣鬼，在拍攝空檔讓大家保持好心情。後來影評人稱讚演出非常自然；Nina 因這部片得獎時，製片和藹地笑了。

questions.questionZh: 那位劇組人員為什麼被送回家？
options: 在電梯裡弄壞了昂貴的攝影機
不聽導演安排的時間表

items.promptZh: 我有幽閉恐懼症，所以我總是走樓梯。
referenceEn: I have claustrophobia, so I always take the stairs.
Because I suffer from claustrophobia, I always use the stairs.
rubricZh: 「幽閉恐懼症」用 claustrophobia，可寫 have claustrophobia、suffer from claustrophobia 等
「走樓梯」可寫，例如 take the stairs、use the stairs 等
說的是習慣，時態配合內容（例如 have、always take）

items.promptZh: 評審稱讚這位年輕演員表演得很自然。
referenceEn: The judges praised the naturalness of the young actor's performance.
The naturalness of the young actor's acting won praise from the judges.
rubricZh: 「自然」用名詞 naturalness（例如 the naturalness of the performance 等）
「稱讚」可寫，例如 praised、won praise from 等
時態配合內容；過去式、現在完成式都正確
